items.stem: Write a function SEARCH() that accepts a record [EmpId, Name, Salary] from the user and appends it to the binary file "EMP.DAT" using pickle.
items.answer:
import pickle
def SEARCH():
    a = int(input("Number: "))
    b = input("Name: ")
    c = int(input("Salary: "))
    with open("EMP.DAT", "ab") as F:
        pickle.dump([a, b, c], F)
